# Skill installation is independent of Cardamom store and board selection.
env CARDAMOM_STORE=$WORK/missing-store
env CARDAMOM_BOARD=missing-board

# A missing skills directory receives the complete runtime skill.
exec card skill install $WORK/skills
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/installed.txt
! stderr .
exists skills/cardamom/SKILL.md
exists skills/cardamom/agents/openai.yaml
exists skills/cardamom/assets/favicon-96x96.png
exists skills/cardamom/assets/apple-touch-icon.png
exists skills/cardamom/references/attachments.md
exists skills/cardamom/references/execution.md
exists skills/cardamom/references/leases.md
exists skills/cardamom/references/planning.md
exists skills/cardamom/references/phased-workflows.md
exists skills/cardamom/references/recovery.md
exists skills/cardamom/references/mail.md
exists skills/cardamom/references/routines.md
exists skills/cardamom/references/scope.md
exists skills/cardamom/scripts/cardamom
exec test -x skills/cardamom/scripts/cardamom
! exists skills/cardamom/tests
! exists .cardamom
cp skills/cardamom/SKILL.md original-skill.md

# Reinstalling identical content reports an unchanged destination.
exec card --json skill install $WORK/skills
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/unchanged.json
! stderr .

# A different destination is preserved unless replacement is requested.
cp $WORK/changed-skill.md skills/cardamom/SKILL.md
cp $WORK/stale-reference.md skills/cardamom/references/stale.md
! exec card skill install $WORK/skills
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr $WORK/golden/conflict.txt
cmp skills/cardamom/SKILL.md $WORK/changed-skill.md
cmp skills/cardamom/references/stale.md $WORK/stale-reference.md

# Forced installation publishes the complete embedded tree.
exec card skill install $WORK/skills --force
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/replaced.txt
! stderr .
cmp skills/cardamom/SKILL.md original-skill.md
! exists skills/cardamom/references/stale.md
! exists skills/cardamom/tests

-- changed-skill.md --
changed
-- stale-reference.md --
stale
-- golden/installed.txt --
installed Cardamom skill at $WORK/skills/cardamom
-- golden/unchanged.json --
{"destination":"$WORK/skills/cardamom","status":"unchanged"}
-- golden/conflict.txt --
error: skill destination "$WORK/skills/cardamom" differs from the embedded Cardamom skill; rerun with --force to replace it
-- golden/replaced.txt --
replaced Cardamom skill at $WORK/skills/cardamom
